tests.preconditions: Two independently provisioned Email/Password accounts; signed-out app.
tests.action: Enter invalid credentials, then authenticate correctly; expect readable rejection and a real currentUser.
tests.actual: Invalid credential error shown; user A authenticated in the real project. Release native-UI login also passed.

tests.preconditions: Live OpenTDB endpoint reachable; no fixture in production.
tests.action: GET exact required URL; decode URL3986; expect exactly five medium Science & Nature boolean questions.
tests.actual: Live encoded panda-question example decoded correctly; five-question app round loaded. Exact endpoint and validation also checked locally.

tests.preconditions: Isolated parser fixtures, never production substitutes.
tests.action: Supply invalid percent escapes, response code, count and metadata; expect rejection.
tests.actual: All malformed-escape, incorrect-category/difficulty/type, response-code, result-count, duplicate-answer and invalid-JSON checks passed.

tests.action: Answer alternately correct/wrong; repeat taps; expect only one answer and at most one point per question.
tests.actual: Five answers yielded 3/5; repeated answers ignored. Release native repeated taps also left correct visible scoring.

tests.preconditions: Five recorded answers and a verified original round.
tests.action: Review all answers; replay; expect cleared answers and a new generated ID.
tests.actual: Five-answer review recorded; final replay had an empty answer list and a different ID.

tests.preconditions: Signed-in A; frozen score=3; allocated original round ID.
tests.action: Submit twice; expect one create-once operation, six fields, resolved timestamp and actual server-only verification.
tests.actual: Real transaction acknowledged; repeated submit ignored; exact six fields; Timestamp resolved; Source.server verified with no pending writes or cached metadata.

tests.preconditions: Original real document exists; application process restarted.
tests.action: Authenticate as same user and retrieve original ID; expect same score/timestamp from server.
tests.actual: Fresh test process reauthenticated A and retrieved original 3/5 document with unchanged timestamp. Installed release force-stop/relaunch also retrieved its own original round.

tests.preconditions: Allocated frozen round; emulator Wi-Fi and mobile data disabled by test helper.
tests.action: Submit offline, restore radios, recover; expect uncertainty and same-ID server verification.
tests.actual: Actual offline attempt reached saveUnknown; after connectivity restoration, the original ID was cloudVerified. Initial SDK-disable-only test failed its expectation and was corrected.

tests.preconditions: Real transaction succeeds; debug hook armed to deny first verification.
tests.action: Observe denial, disable hook, retry same server read; expect preserved record, same ID and verification only after server success.
tests.actual: Real WRITE_ACK followed by injected permission-denied; actual server document remained present. Same-ID retry reached Cloud verified. No replacement round was allocated.

tests.preconditions: A owns original record; B authenticated independently.
tests.action: B reads A record and creates under A path; expect server permission-denied.
tests.actual: Both real deployed-rule operations returned permission-denied.

tests.action: Try score 6, extra field, update and deletion; expect rejection.
tests.actual: All four real deployed-rule operations rejected with permission-denied.

tests.preconditions: Real committed document; labeled one-shot repository fault injection.
tests.action: Inject unavailable/resource-exhausted, attempt immediate retry, then bounded recovery; expect no overlap or duplicate.
tests.actual: Both fault codes produced verificationUnavailable after acknowledgement; immediate retry blocked; delayed server-only retry succeeded; createOnce count stayed one. Separate delayed acknowledgement and account-change tests also passed.

server_verification: Flutter Source.server checks passed in the original run and after fresh-process reauthentication; hasPendingWrites=false, isFromCache=false. A supplementary owner-authenticated REST GET also returned HTTP 200 with the exact six fields. Device event clocks and server timestamps may differ after host sleep; server submittedAt is authoritative.
